s1.syndrome_frame: febrile illness with neurological deterioration and lymphadenopathy
key_facts: cervical and inguinal lymphadenopathy with maximum diameter of 15mm
seizures and loss of consciousness developed later
antinuclear antibodies positive at 1:100 with speckled pattern
cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated nucleated cells count and protein level
normal glucose and chlorides in cerebrospinal fluid
leptomeninges thickening and enhancement on cranial MRI

raw.syndrome_frame: febrile illness with neurological deterioration and lymphadenopathy
key_facts: cervical and inguinal lymphadenopathy with maximum diameter of 15mm
seizures and loss of consciousness developed later
antinuclear antibodies positive at 1:100 with speckled pattern

differentials: Histiocytosis of the Central Nervous System

per_call: Histiocytosis of the Central Nervous System

shortlist.label: Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis
shortlist.why_kept: elevated fever, lymphadenopathy, and hemophagocytosis in bone marrow smear

shortlist.label: Infectious Mononucleosis
shortlist.why_kept: lymphadenopathy, fever, and positive antinuclear antibodies

shortlist.label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: positive antinuclear antibodies, lymphadenopathy, and neurological deterioration

shortlist.label: Histiocytic Necrotizing Lymphadenitis
shortlist.why_kept: lymphadenopathy, fever, and histopathological findings of necrotizing lymphadenitis

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including unremitting fever, headache, lymphadenopathy, and seizures, along with laboratory findings such as hemophagocytosis in bone marrow smear, elevated cerebrospinal fluid nucleated cells count and protein level, and moderately enlarged spleen, are consistent with Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis. The presence of histiocytes and hemophagocytosis in bone marrow smear is a key diagnostic feature of this condition.

rejected.label: Infectious Mononucleosis
rejected.why: Although the patient has a classmate with influenza A infection, the presence of hemophagocytosis and other laboratory findings are not typical of Infectious Mononucleosis

rejected.label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
rejected.why: The patient's antinuclear antibodies were positive, but the clinical presentation and other laboratory findings do not support a diagnosis of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus

rejected.label: Kikuchi-Fujimoto Disease
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and laboratory findings, such as seizures and hemophagocytosis, are not typical of Kikuchi-Fujimoto Disease

rejected.label: Histiocytic Necrotizing Lymphadenitis
rejected.why: Although the patient has lymphadenopathy and histiocytic necrotizing lymphadenitis was seen on lymph node biopsy, the presence of hemophagocytosis and other systemic symptoms suggest a more widespread disease process, such as Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis
